title: Lahar deposits from Kanlaon volcano to be cleared

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – About 23 haulers have expressed interest in removing 67,530 cubic meters of lahar deposits clogging Ibid Creek in Barangay Biak-na-Bato, La Castellana town, Negros Occidental, the Provincial Environment and Management Office (PEMO) said. PEMO chief Julie Bedrio said clearing operations for the volcanic debris will be underway shortly after the provincial government received an Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources–Environmental Management Bureau (DENR-EMB).
